proposal.description:
## Summary

Allow users to export their tasks to a CSV file from the Tasks page to facilitate data portability and backups.

## Background

- There is currently no way for users to export their task data from the app.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A user can click an "Export to CSV" button on the Tasks page.
- [ ] The exported file contains all tasks with their titles, descriptions, due dates, statuses, and project names.

## Estimate

**2 days** · AI estimate
Design the export logic, implement the CSV generation service, and add the UI button to the Tasks page.

## Original request
